view.title: Ch.17 Boundaries - plugin architecture (illustrative wiki system)
view.caption: An illustrative wiki system (FitNesse-style) partitioned into a core and plugins. The core business rules OWN the WikiPage interface; every plugin (the UI, the page stores, the web framework) IMPLEMENTS that interface and DEPENDS ON the core. Every arrow points TOWARD the core - the core has zero outgoing dependencies. This is the asymmetric plugin relationship: a plugin cannot break the core, the core can swap any plugin at will. The boundary is drawn across the inheritance arrows just below the core's interface - the same boundary that let FitNesse defer the database decision for 18 months and ultimately abandon it.
